recommended_task.name: SinD-IC4 target-centered interaction-residual forecasting
recommended_task.origin_grid: t0=19+10k; require t0-19 and t0+40 inside assigned recording split
recommended_task.coordinate_system: target-local, origin at last sensed position, ego_v1 historical heading; final inverse rotation/translation to world meters
recommended_task.heading_rule: latest sensed velocity norm>=0.2m/s; otherwise latest displacement then nonzero velocity norm>=1e-4; otherwise x-axis with has_direction=false; no future yaw
recommended_task.target_definition: each unique(scene,t0,original_track_id) with20 consecutive finite observed history frames, four-wheel class car/bus/truck; criterion k>=1; no future completeness filter
recommended_task.higher_order_stratum: k>=2, reported without making it primary inclusion
recommended_task.model_training_population: same full history-admitted train cohort for every model; no outcome-based subsampling or risk oversampling
recommended_task.correction_bound: no inherited16m hard cap in new 40-step decoder; common unbounded linear coordinate heads, same zero initialization and gradient clipping for all models
recommended_task.decoder_scope: new horizon-aware wrapper/head only after review; existing official models unchanged

auxiliary_task.name: SinD-Full4
auxiliary_task.description: Exactly the same horizon/splits/targets/labels, without k>=1 inclusion; k=0/1/2+ are strata, not additional benchmarks

thresholds.FOLLOW_formula: speed_i>=0.5 AND speed_j>=0.5 AND cos(theta_i-theta_j)>=cos30deg AND longitudinal_offset>0 AND abs(lateral_offset)<=2.5 AND longitudinal_offset/max(speed_i,0.5)<=2
thresholds.ttc_role: diagnostic only; 5m center-envelope quadratic collision proxy, not TCPA and not an oriented-rectangle safety TTC

threshold_sources.radius: 50m has SMART2024 precedent; selected before new statistics
threshold_sources.tcpa: prediction horizon, not a collision emergency threshold
threshold_sources.dcpa: prespecified engineering interaction envelope, NOT a universal literature/safety standard
threshold_sources.closing: prespecified0.5m/s inherited interpretable scale, NOT a statistically certified noise bound
threshold_sources.following: prespecified geometric/headway heuristic; NOT guaranteed same-lane or actual yielding

neighbor_graph.context_eligibility: 20 complete finite historical observations; independent of neighbor future availability
neighbor_graph.ranking: interaction flag first; then TTC_envelope asc, DCPA asc for 0<TCPA<=40dt else infinity, closing desc, distance asc, deterministic raw-history lexicographic key, ID only exact-tie tie-breaker
neighbor_graph.shared_context: target plus top7; target and neighbor histories all supplied; neighbor futures never inputs; geometry over every chosen pair
neighbor_graph.edge_features: classical strong graph derives relative position/velocity,distance,closing,TCPA,DCPA,CPA/follow flags from identical observed histories; Raj core retains its existing feature implementation
neighbor_graph.strong_graph_unrestricted_control: all eligible neighbors within50m, ragged/padded, no cap8; never remove crowded samples to avoid truncation
neighbor_graph.caveat: zero lost immediate risk edges does not imply all predictive context retained;80.8%/68.9% full targets have>7 neighbors

expected_sample_counts.count_type: exact audited history-membership; label-availability counts are metadata-based, future numerical target tensors not built

split_policy.unit: physical recording time with identity purge; never random overlapping-window split
split_policy.inner_dev: last15% of fit for epoch/config choice;60frame gap and crossing-ID purge; design untouched until each predeclared candidate configuration is fixed
split_policy.physical_ID_purge: drop trajectories appearing in more than one split, identified by frame metadata; recompute neighborhoods after each partition purge
split_policy.test_metadata: downloaded raw bytes and scanned frame/ID availability only; test numerical states not parsed and no test labels/metrics opened
split_policy.formal_val_policy: historically reused by project; this run history-statistics-only; prospective one-shot confirmation after thresholds/configurations freeze, no threshold or epoch search
split_policy.new_data_paths: data/task_redesign/IC4_v1/{train_fit,train_dev,train_design,train,val}; no test builder enabled before authorization
split_policy.final_refit: After selecting config and median best epoch on internaldev, refit outertrain for that fixed duration; one formalval confirmation, no epoch search

label_policy.future_mask: per-step observed finite GT; no interpolation, extrapolation, or padding treated as truth
label_policy.FDE_mask: only true final40th timestamp; report denominator/coverage
label_policy.ADE: mean over observed future timestamps per target, then targets per origin, then origins
label_policy.zero_label_targets: remain in membership; no supervised gradient/metric possible; report count, never silently remove
label_policy.horizon_comparison: use common history-origin membership and shared endpoint masks for paired contrasts; native coverage also reported; no future maneuver/error selection

metrics.checkpoint: one checkpoint minimizing origin_macro_ADE+0.5*origin_macro_FDE on train-internal stopping-dev critical cohort; always report both from same checkpoint
metrics.training_loss: common origin-macro(ADE+0.5FDE) over full training cohort; token auxiliary identical controls and ablated weight0/0.035; no separate ADE-best/FDE-best reporting
metrics.confidence: paired bootstrap stratified by recording with30s temporal blocks and separate physical-track cluster sensitivity;5paired seeds; no IID window CI; claims conditional on these2recordings

gate_S.comparator: single best classical self family selected by internaldev J, not per-sample oracle or different models per metric
gate_S.meaning: project minimum worthwhile effect, not a literature theorem
gate_S.failure_action: keep task frozen, report GPT2 not an accuracy contribution; fix/ablate LLM module only, or use best classical self and revise paper claim

prospective_threshold.per_city_gain_sign: nonnegative ADE and FDE, with denominators/uncertainty disclosed

gate_G.comparator: best self-only including GPT2 if it wins versus strongest fixed classical neighbor model; matched own-only correction control mandatory
gate_G.long_horizon_story: separate test that GraphGain40-GraphGain20 has positive paired95CI; if absent, do not claim horizon amplifies interaction
gate_G.failure_action: do not retune risk thresholds or openQ; fall back to the already-retained Full4 as an ordinary forecasting task without interaction-necessity claims
gate_G.architecture_claim_limit: gain versus self proves usefulness of neighbor information, not necessity of a particular graph architecture; graph versusDeepSets is separate

literature_sources.title: SinD: A Drone Dataset at Signalized Intersection in China
literature_sources.supports: Original SinD provenance; not statistics for our two public v2 recordings

literature_sources.title: SinD 2.0: A Multi-City UAV Dataset with Semantic Risk Annotations for SOTIF-Oriented Safety Validation at Signalized Intersections
literature_sources.supports: Multi-city intersection context; section VI reports 50/60 QCNet and31/52 Diffuser protocols, explicitly not a standardized leaderboard; smoothing causality not established

literature_sources.title: InterHub: A Naturalistic Trajectory Dataset with Dense Interaction for Autonomous Driving
literature_sources.supports: Interaction is predicted conflict/behavioral dependence, not density alone; trajectory-event extraction cannot be imported as online inclusion unmodified

literature_sources.title: SMART: Scalable Multi-agent Real-time Simulation via Next-token Prediction
literature_sources.supports: Motion tokens and temporal/agent interaction factorization; 50m neighboring-agent radius in section3.2; not proof of textual GPT2 pretraining advantage

literature_sources.title: One Fits All: Power General Time Series Analysis by Pretrained LM
literature_sources.supports: Positive evidence for pretrained frozen transformer transfer under studied time-series settings, especially small-data ablations; not SinD-specific

literature_sources.title: Are Language Models Actually Useful for Time Series Forecasting?
literature_sources.supports: Counterevidence: removal/replacement and random-init ablations often retain or improve accuracy; requires controlled pretraining tests

literature_sources.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
literature_sources.supports: Frozen W plus low-rank BA adaptation; parameter efficiency does not prove domain-transfer accuracy

literature_sources.title: Kinematics-Aware Multigraph Attention Network with Residual Learning for Heterogeneous Trajectory Prediction
literature_sources.supports: Physics-plus-residual graph forecasting precedent, not causal identification of pure interaction residual

literature_sources.title: FHWA SSAM Software User Manual
literature_sources.supports: TTC/PET conflict thresholds, e.g.1.5s; not justification for equating TCPA with TTC or declaring DCPA5m an industry standard

literature_sources.title: Argoverse Motion Forecasting User Guide
literature_sources.supports: Target/context distinction and multi-second trajectory scenes; do not copy raw metrics across tasks
literature_sources.publication_date_status: official living documentation; publication year not established
